confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Athens price levels; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because July peak-season rates vary widely by district, date and lead time; they approximate typical all-in nightly prices including VAT and the Greek accommodation levy. Cocktail was set at about twice the draft-beer anchor and wine glass close to it, because direct knowledge of Athens bar pricing is weaker. The FX value comes from the RBA exchange-rates overview page surfaced by search; the F11 table row itself was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No live price data was used. Benchmarked against southern European capitals with similar tourist demand, such as Lisbon and Rome, for restaurant and cafe prices; Athens casual dining is generally priced at or below those comparables. Accommodation anchors are set against the same comparables with a July peak-season premium applied.
